sections.text_helper: Section 56.4.24 "Debug mode" in chapter 56 (General-purpose timers (TIM9/TIM10/TIM11/TIM12/TIM13/TIM14)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2791.
sections.section_content:
When the microcontroller enters debug mode (Cortex®-M55 core halted), the TIMx counter
can either continue to work normally or stop.
The behavior in debug mode can be programmed with a dedicated configuration bit per
timer in the Debug support (DBG) module.
For more details, refer to the Debug section.
